summary: Timeboxed approval: scoped session snapshot with tokenized identifiers for customer data remediation
description:
Issue summary:
Request from CS for a scoped session snapshot containing tokenized identifiers to support a customer remediation request. Customer data will be pseudonymized (tokenized identifiers only) before export. We need authorization for a timeboxed, two-person-control extraction from prod logs.

Impact:
- Customer remediation (billing/payment reconciliation) is blocked until we provide a verifiable snapshot.
- Potential privacy/regulatory exposure if extraction is mishandled; requires minimal exposure and audit trail.

Environment:
- Production cluster (us-east), service: api-gateway -> inference-serving -> request-logger -> s3-archive
- Time window requested: 2026-03-03T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-04T03:00:00Z
- Snapshot scope: session records matching customer_customer_id=acct_7w4ty (CS provided hashed id), redact PII fields, replace user identifiers with stable tokens.

Request details / Steps to reproduce: 
1) CS initiated remediation case CUS-44421; asked for a list of sessions and tokenized identifiers where payment retry occurred.
2) Support needs a 1) minimal session snapshot (headers, routing decisions, timestamps, model id, response status) and 2) token mapping table with ephemeral token => internal-id (tokenized only).
3) Proposed extraction path: run the scoped psql query on redact-prod-logs read-only replica, then post-process with redaction script (ops/redact/tokenize_v2) and seal output in KMS-wrapped bucket.

Logs / Evidence: 
- Kibana link (internal): https://kibana.redwood.ai/app/discover#/?_a=(query:(query_string:(query:'customer_id:acct_7w4ty AND status:retry')))
- Related incident note: See INT-701233 for prior approvals and audit checklist.

Requested controls / safeguards: 
- Timeboxed access: 4 hours of data extraction window, max one operator and one auditor (two-person control).
- Output must be written encrypted to KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/xxxx and retention limited to 30 days.
- Automated redaction run and verification steps must be recorded; redaction report attached to the audit entry.
- No raw payload or generated-text outputs (token-only allowed).

Approval asks: 
- Security/Privacy sign-off on redaction script version (ops/redact/tokenize_v2 commit ae3b9f2).
- Legal confirmation that tokenized mapping is acceptable for the remediation scope.
- Ops to nominate operator and auditor and schedule extraction window.

Notes: 
- CS indicates customer is enterprise-tier with active SLA; remediation deadline 2026-03-14.
- If approved, follow runbook steps under the linked Confluence page and attach redaction verification in ticket before closing.
investigation_notes: Initial triage by support: verified customer_id hash and referenced CUS ticket. Confirmed no prior full payload exports exist for this customer in the requested window. Hypothesis: payment retry originated from a routing fallback and can be identified by 'retry' marker in request metadata. Confirmed redact script exists and has unit tests but no recent production run; require privacy to validate script output on a small synthetic sample before prod run.

next_steps: 1) Privacy to approve tokenization approach after a synthetic-staging run (owner: Priya Desai). 2) Legal to confirm retention window and escrow terms (owner: Emily Zhao). 3) Ops/SRE to schedule 2-hour extraction window and nominate operator+auditor. 4) After approvals, run extraction, store KMS-wrapped, attach redaction verification, and close ticket.
notes_for_audit: Two-person-control checklist required: operator username, auditor username, extraction start/end times, KMS key ARN, S3 path, redaction script commit hash, redaction verification report. All entries must be appended to this ticket prior to closure.
